contact_submission_read_state_valid.name: contact_submission_read_state_valid
contact_submission_read_state_valid.value: ("contact_submission"."status" != 'unread' or "contact_submission"."read_at" is null) and ("contact_submission"."status" != 'read' or "contact_submission"."read_at" is not null)

national_olympiad_stage_start_iso.name: national_olympiad_stage_start_iso
national_olympiad_stage_start_iso.value: "national_olympiad_stage"."starts_on" is null or ("national_olympiad_stage"."starts_on" glob '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' and date("national_olympiad_stage"."starts_on", '+0 days') is "national_olympiad_stage"."starts_on")

national_olympiad_stage_end_iso.name: national_olympiad_stage_end_iso
national_olympiad_stage_end_iso.value: "national_olympiad_stage"."ends_on" is null or ("national_olympiad_stage"."ends_on" glob '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' and date("national_olympiad_stage"."ends_on", '+0 days') is "national_olympiad_stage"."ends_on")

national_olympiad_stage_range_valid.name: national_olympiad_stage_range_valid
national_olympiad_stage_range_valid.value: "national_olympiad_stage"."ends_on" is null or ("national_olympiad_stage"."starts_on" is not null and "national_olympiad_stage"."ends_on" >= "national_olympiad_stage"."starts_on")

news_article_date_published_iso.name: news_article_date_published_iso
news_article_date_published_iso.value: "news_article"."published_on" is null or ("news_article"."published_on" glob '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' and date("news_article"."published_on", '+0 days') is "news_article"."published_on")

news_article_status_valid.name: news_article_status_valid
news_article_status_valid.value: "news_article"."status" in ('draft', 'published') and ("news_article"."status" != 'published' or "news_article"."published_on" is not null)
